description: DiligenceOps: submit one support conversation excerpt, as a chat, email thread or ticket. The signed brief states who speaks for support and who is the customer, the issue raised, the current status, every promise support made with its amount and deadline, and the stated next step with who owns it, each quoted. POST /api/support-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-vendor-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the conversation, recorded in the brief.

text.description: One support conversation excerpt: chat, email thread or ticket, up to 256 KB.
